# proof-cli

> Unofficial command-line interface and MCP server for the Proof API (proof.com): remote online notarization, e-signature, identity verification, real-estate closings, SCIM provisioning, certificates, and verifiable credentials. Every command prints the API's JSON; errors exit 1.

## Docs

- [Agent usage guide (skill)](https://github.com/tsarlewey/proof-cli/blob/main/skills/proof/SKILL.md): setup, safety rules, core workflow, command map
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/tsarlewey/proof-cli/blob/main/AGENTS.md): install, MCP, and plugin entry points
- [README](https://github.com/tsarlewey/proof-cli/blob/main/README.md): full command reference with examples
- [Releases](https://github.com/tsarlewey/proof-cli/releases): prebuilt binaries for macOS, Linux, and Windows

## Related

- [proof-sdk-go](https://github.com/tsarlewey/proof-sdk-go): the Go SDK this CLI is built on
- [Proof API reference](https://dev.proof.com/reference)
